publish: local only: swechat is HF-gated; do not publish until the gate terms are confirmed (DESIGN.md §6.3, open item 8)
selection_rule: Fixed before any session was looked at: the first session by sorted session_id among the unit's sessions in the split's IR cache that has 12 to 30 call events, a request_id on at least one assistant/call/meta row, and millisecond-resolution timestamps (>= 3 fractional digits) on every call and result.
